text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the monthly churn limit, **<4% per month**, could not be checked in this model.

- The MRR-only comparison is moderately robust under the tested assumptions, but it is not a valid answer to your combined MRR-and-churn question.
- Results partly rest on Olumi-authored estimates, and Non‑Pro MRR had no starting value, so the analysis used a default of 0; that makes downstream MRR results unreliable.
- The price-to-MRR relationship was the most fragile tested link: changing that link could alter the comparison. This is a property of that edge, not an overall measure of stability.
